lessons.title: Can you play basketball?
grammar: 会 · 能 · 可以
会 = a learned skill. 能 = ability or circumstances. 可以 = permission or possibility.
我会打篮球，但是今天不能去。
I can play basketball, but I cannot go today.
跟……一起
Place the companion before the activity.
我跟朋友一起看电影。
I watch movies with friends.
爱好 / 喜欢
Use 我的爱好是 + activity, or 我喜欢 + activity.
我的爱好是听音乐。
My hobby is listening to music.

lessons.title: I want to be a flight attendant
grammar: 因为……所以……
Give a reason, then its result. You can also use only 因为.
因为我喜欢旅游，所以我想当导游。
Because I like travelling, I want to be a tour guide.
最 + adjective / 喜欢
最 expresses “most” or a favourite.
我最喜欢冬天。
I like winter best.
毕业以后 + 打算 / 想
Explain a plan after graduating.
毕业以后，我打算去国外工作。
After graduation, I plan to work abroad.
一样
Use A 跟 B 一样 to say two things are alike.
今天跟昨天一样冷。
Today is as cold as yesterday.

lessons.title: What would you like to eat?
grammar: Number + measure word + noun
Match the measure word to the thing ordered: 盘, 碗, 瓶.
我要一碗面条和一瓶水。
I would like a bowl of noodles and a bottle of water.
有点儿 vs 一点儿
有点儿 comes before an adjective (often an unwelcome quality); 一点儿 expresses a small quantity or degree.
这件衣服有点儿贵。便宜一点儿吧。
These clothes are a little expensive. A little cheaper, please.
多少 / 多少钱
Ask quantity or price; answer with a number and currency.
这些一共多少钱？
How much are these altogether?
还是
In a question, 还是 offers a choice. Answer with your choice.
你想喝茶还是咖啡？
Would you like tea or coffee?

grammar: 门 vs 节
门 counts subjects/courses. 节 counts class periods.
今天我有两节汉语课。
I have two periods of Chinese today.
有 / 没有
Use 没有 to negate possession/existence, including classes and exams.
明天我没有英语课。
I do not have English class tomorrow.
得: de / dé / děi
Neutral de introduces a complement; dé means get; děi means have to. The MDL “ought to” card mixes these labels.
这次考试我得了九十分。
I got 90 points on this exam.
换 + amount + currency
Listen carefully for the currency and the amount. Rates in drills are examples only.
我要换五百元人民币。
I would like to exchange for 500 yuan.

在……附近 / 里边 / 中间

The restaurant is near the sports centre.
怎么去 vs 去哪儿
怎么去 asks how you travel; 去哪儿 asks your destination.

I walk to the library.

grammar: Verb + 过
过 describes a past experience. Negate with 没有.
我去过泰国，但是没去过中国。
I have been to Thailand, but not to China.
Duration + 了
Use a duration with 了 for a situation continuing now.
我来泰国两个月了。
I have been in Thailand for two months.

vocab.english: 3 yuan and 5 jiao; also 三块五 sān kuài wǔ

groups.title: Hobbies
groups.note: Both questions ask about hobbies. Replace the sample hobbies with your own.

items.meaning: What is your hobby?
items.ap: Wǒ de àihào shì tīng yīnyuè.
items.translation: My hobby is listening to music.

items.meaning: What hobbies do you have?
items.ap: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng hé pǎobù.
items.translation: I like watching movies and running.

groups.title: Abilities
groups.note: Use 会 for a learned ability. Substitute: 踢足球 tī zúqiú (play football), 唱歌 chànggē (sing), 写书法 xiě shūfǎ (do calligraphy), 做饭 zuòfàn (cook), 游泳 yóuyǒng (swim). Answer the activity you actually hear.

items.meaning: Can you play basketball?
items.ap: Wǒ huì dǎ lánqiú.
items.translation: I can play basketball.

items.meaning: Can you swim?
items.ap: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng.
items.translation: I cannot swim.

groups.title: Weather and seasons
groups.note: For today/yesterday use the real weather. China has varied weather; specify a season or place when appropriate. These are language examples, not current weather reports. 秋天 qiūtiān means autumn.

items.q: 你觉得今天天气怎么样？
items.meaning: What do you think of today’s weather?
items.ap: Wǒ juéde jīntiān tiānqì hěn rè.
items.translation: I think it is hot today.

items.q: 你觉得昨天天气怎么样？
items.meaning: What do you think yesterday’s weather was like?
items.a: 我觉得昨天天气很凉快。
items.ap: Wǒ juéde zuótiān tiānqì hěn liángkuai.
items.translation: I think it was cool yesterday.

items.q: 你觉得泰国天气怎么样？
items.meaning: What do you think of Thailand’s weather?
items.ap: Wǒ juéde Tàiguó tiānqì hěn rè.
items.translation: I think Thailand’s weather is hot.

items.q: 你觉得中国天气怎么样？
items.meaning: What do you think of China’s weather?
items.ap: Wǒ juéde Zhōngguó dōngtiān hěn lěng.
items.translation: I think winter in China is cold.

items.meaning: Which season do you like best?
items.ap: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan dōngtiān.
items.translation: I like winter best.

groups.title: Career after graduation
groups.note: Choose your real goal. Alternatives: 医生 yīshēng (doctor), 老师 lǎoshī (teacher), 工程师 gōngchéngshī (engineer), 空姐 kōngjiě (female flight attendant).

items.qp: Bìyè yǐhòu, nǐ xiǎng dāng shénme?
items.meaning: What do you want to be after graduation?
items.a: 毕业以后，我想当工程师。
items.ap: Bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ xiǎng dāng gōngchéngshī.
items.translation: After graduation, I want to be an engineer.

groups.title: Food and drinks
groups.note: Listen for 吃 (eat) or 喝 (drink). Keep the verb and object matched.

items.meaning: What would you like to eat?
items.ap: Wǒ xiǎng chī jiǎozi.
items.translation: I would like to eat dumplings.

items.meaning: What would you like to drink?
items.ap: Wǒ xiǎng hē chá.
items.translation: I would like to drink tea.

groups.title: Your Chinese teacher
groups.note: The Classroom posts are by Peng Liu. The example below uses 刘老师 (Teacher Liu); confirm that this is how you address your actual Chinese teacher.

items.meaning: Who teaches you Chinese?
items.ap: Liú lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen Hànyǔ.
items.translation: Teacher Liu teaches us Chinese.

groups.title: Exchanging money
groups.note: These amounts are practice examples. Currency substitutions: 泰铢 Tàizhū (Thai baht), 美元 měiyuán (US dollars), 人民币 rénmínbì (renminbi), 欧元 ōuyuán (euros). Use the currency heard in the question.

items.meaning: What currency do you want to exchange for?
items.ap: Wǒ yào huàn Tàizhū.
items.translation: I want to exchange for Thai baht.

items.meaning: How much Thai baht do you want to exchange for?
items.ap: Wǒ yào huàn sān qiān Tàizhū.
items.translation: I want to exchange for 3,000 baht.

items.meaning: How many US dollars do you want to exchange for?
items.ap: Wǒ yào huàn yì bǎi měiyuán.
items.translation: I want to exchange for 100 US dollars.

items.meaning: How much renminbi do you want to exchange for?
items.ap: Wǒ yào huàn wǔ bǎi yuán rénmínbì.
items.translation: I want to exchange for 500 yuan.

items.meaning: How many euros do you want to exchange for?
items.ap: Wǒ yào huàn yì bǎi ōuyuán.
items.translation: I want to exchange for 100 euros.

groups.title: Exchange rates
groups.note: Fill each blank with the rate your teacher supplies or a rate checked on the test date. No live exchange rate is claimed here. The source says 一人民币; standard phrasing is 一元人民币. 港币 gǎngbì = Hong Kong dollars.

items.q: 今天一美元换多少泰铢？
items.qp: Jīntiān yì měiyuán huàn duōshao Tàizhū?
items.meaning: How many baht does one US dollar buy today?
items.a: 今天一美元大概换＿＿泰铢。
items.ap: Jīntiān yì měiyuán dàgài huàn __ Tàizhū.
items.translation: Today one US dollar exchanges for about __ baht.

items.q: 今天一元人民币换多少泰铢？
items.qp: Jīntiān yì yuán rénmínbì huàn duōshao Tàizhū?
items.meaning: How many baht does one yuan buy today?
items.a: 今天一元人民币大概换＿＿泰铢。
items.ap: Jīntiān yì yuán rénmínbì dàgài huàn __ Tàizhū.
items.translation: Today one yuan exchanges for about __ baht.

items.q: 今天一美元换多少港币？
items.qp: Jīntiān yì měiyuán huàn duōshao gǎngbì?
items.meaning: How many Hong Kong dollars does one US dollar buy today?
items.a: 今天一美元大概换＿＿港币。
items.ap: Jīntiān yì měiyuán dàgài huàn __ gǎngbì.
items.translation: Today one US dollar exchanges for about __ Hong Kong dollars.

items.q: 今天一元人民币换多少港币？
items.qp: Jīntiān yì yuán rénmínbì huàn duōshao gǎngbì?
items.meaning: How many Hong Kong dollars does one yuan buy today?
items.a: 今天一元人民币大概换＿＿港币。
items.ap: Jīntiān yì yuán rénmínbì dàgài huàn __ gǎngbì.
items.translation: Today one yuan exchanges for about __ Hong Kong dollars.

groups.title: Choosing between alternatives
groups.note: 还是 asks you to choose. Answer with the choice, not just 是 or 好. Nationality examples are options, not claims about you. If neither choice is true, say your actual nationality; e.g. 我是缅甸人 Wǒ shì Miǎndiàn rén (I am from Myanmar), only if true.

items.q: 你是泰国人还是中国人？
items.qp: Nǐ shì Tàiguó rén háishi Zhōngguó rén?
items.meaning: Are you Thai or Chinese?
items.ap: Wǒ shì Tàiguó rén.
items.translation: I am Thai. [Replace with your nationality.]

items.qp: Nǐ xiǎng hē kāfēi háishi chá?
items.meaning: Would you like coffee or tea?
items.ap: Wǒ xiǎng hē chá.
items.translation: I would like tea.

items.qp: Nǐ xǐhuan hē kāfēi háishi chá?
items.meaning: Do you prefer drinking coffee or tea?
items.ap: Wǒ xǐhuan hē kāfēi.
items.translation: I prefer drinking coffee.

groups.title: Your classes
groups.note: Use your real timetable. Swap 今天 jīntiān, 昨天 zuótiān, 明天 míngtiān and 英语 Yīngyǔ, 泰语 Tàiyǔ, 汉语 Hànyǔ as asked. Use 没有, not 不有. 节 jié counts class periods; 门 mén counts subjects/courses.

items.qp: Jīntiān nǐ yǒu méiyǒu Hànyǔ kè?
items.meaning: Do you have Chinese class today?
items.ap: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu Hànyǔ kè.
items.translation: I have Chinese class today.

items.qp: Zuótiān nǐ yǒu méiyǒu Yīngyǔ kè?
items.meaning: Did you have English class yesterday?
items.ap: Zuótiān wǒ méiyǒu Yīngyǔ kè.
items.translation: I did not have English class yesterday.

items.qp: Míngtiān nǐ yǒu méiyǒu Tàiyǔ kè?
items.meaning: Do you have Thai class tomorrow?
items.ap: Míngtiān wǒ méiyǒu Tàiyǔ kè.
items.translation: I do not have Thai class tomorrow.

items.meaning: What classes do you have tomorrow?
items.a: 明天我有汉语课和英语课。
items.ap: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu Hànyǔ kè hé Yīngyǔ kè.
items.translation: Tomorrow I have Chinese and English classes.

items.qp: Jīntiān nǐ yǒu jǐ jié kè?
items.meaning: How many class periods do you have today?
items.ap: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu liǎng jié kè.
items.translation: I have two class periods today.

groups.title: Places and transport
groups.note: 去哪儿 asks WHERE; 怎么去 asks HOW. Substitute 走路 zǒulù (walk), 坐公共汽车 zuò gōnggòng qìchē (take a bus), 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē (ride a bicycle), 骑摩托车 qí mótuōchē (ride a motorcycle), 开车 kāichē (drive).

items.qp: Xiàkè yǐhòu, nǐ yào qù nǎr?
items.meaning: Where will you go after class?
items.a: 下课以后，我要去图书馆。
items.ap: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào qù túshūguǎn.
items.translation: After class I will go to the library.

items.meaning: How do you get to the supermarket?
items.ap: Wǒ zǒulù qù chāoshì.
items.translation: I walk to the supermarket.

items.meaning: How do you get to the hospital?
items.ap: Wǒ zuò chūzūchē qù yīyuàn.
items.translation: I take a taxi to the hospital.

groups.title: Colour and prices
groups.note: Use the colour you are wearing and realistic prices for your own items. All amounts below are examples. Colours: 白色 báisè, 黑色 hēisè, 红色 hóngsè, 蓝色 lánsè, 绿色 lǜsè, 黄色 huángsè. Keep the currency explicit.

items.qp: Nǐ de yīfu shì shénme yánsè?
items.meaning: What colour are your clothes?
items.ap: Wǒ de yīfu shì hēisè de.
items.translation: My clothes are black.

items.meaning: How much do your clothes cost?
items.a: 我的衣服四百八十泰铢。
items.ap: Wǒ de yīfu sì bǎi bā shí Tàizhū.
items.translation: My clothes cost 480 baht.

items.meaning: How much does your phone cost?
items.ap: Wǒ de shǒujī yí wàn Tàizhū.
items.translation: My phone costs 10,000 baht.

items.meaning: How much does your computer cost?
items.ap: Wǒ de diànnǎo liǎng wàn Tàizhū.
items.translation: My computer costs 20,000 baht.

groups.title: Exams and time
groups.note: Use your actual exam schedule. Swap today/tomorrow and Chinese/Thai/English as asked. A time answer can be a day, a date, or a time of day.

items.qp: Jīntiān nǐ yǒu Hànyǔ kǎoshì ma?
items.meaning: Do you have a Chinese exam today?
items.ap: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu Hànyǔ kǎoshì.
items.translation: I have a Chinese exam today.

items.qp: Míngtiān nǐ yǒu Yīngyǔ kǎoshì ma?
items.meaning: Do you have an English exam tomorrow?
items.ap: Míngtiān wǒ méiyǒu Yīngyǔ kǎoshì.
items.translation: I do not have an English exam tomorrow.

items.meaning: When is your exam?
items.ap: Wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn kǎoshì.
items.translation: My exam is tomorrow at 9 a.m.

groups.title: Distance
groups.note: Pattern: A 离 B 有 + distance. 公里 gōnglǐ = kilometre; 米 mǐ = metre. Fill the actual distance or the figure taught in class. Bangkok–Chiang Rai distance depends on road versus straight-line measurement. No distance is asserted here.

items.qp: Màngǔ lí Qīnglái yǒu duō yuǎn?
items.meaning: How far is Bangkok from Chiang Rai?
items.a: 曼谷离清莱大概有＿＿公里。
items.ap: Màngǔ lí Qīnglái dàgài yǒu __ gōnglǐ.
items.translation: Bangkok is about __ kilometres from Chiang Rai.

items.qp: Túshūguǎn lí sùshè yǒu duō yuǎn?
items.meaning: How far is the library from the dormitory?
items.a: 图书馆离宿舍大概有＿＿米。
items.ap: Túshūguǎn lí sùshè dàgài yǒu __ mǐ.
items.translation: The library is about __ metres from the dormitory.

items.qp: Nǐ jiā lí xuéxiào yǒu duō yuǎn?
items.meaning: How far is your home from school?
items.a: 我家离学校大概有＿＿公里。
items.ap: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào dàgài yǒu __ gōnglǐ.
items.translation: My home is about __ kilometres from school.
